content.bridge_context: Exploring numbers that go below zero, useful for representing debt, depth, or freezing temperatures.

units.title: Below Zero
units.explanation: Integers include positive numbers, zero, and negative numbers.
units.dual_language_instruction: If you owe someone 5 rupees, it's like having -5 rupees. / यदि आप पर किसी का 5 रुपये बकाया है, तो यह -5 रुपये होने जैसा है।

units.title: The Number Line
units.explanation: On a number line, negative numbers are to the left of zero.
units.dual_language_instruction: Draw a line and mark -1, 0, and 1. / एक रेखा खींचें और -1, 0 और 1 अंकित करें।
